opening: Here is a brief digest of the strongest matches from the week.
closing: That is the set for this window; the rest stayed quiet or off topic.

topics.title: Perseverance sets an off-world driving record
topics.summary: NASA said Perseverance reached 28.10 miles driven on Mars on Oct. 11, passing the 28.06-mile record set by Opportunity. The rover now holds the record for total distance driven on another world.
topics.detail: NASA said the rover’s odometer hit the mark on Oct. 11. The agency said the total eclipsed Opportunity’s distance of 28.06 miles, set during its Mars mission from 2004 to 2018.

topics.title: Study points to a shortcut to fusion energy
topics.summary: ScienceDaily reported that Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory researchers may have found a more efficient route to fusion energy by heating plasma first and then increasing its density. The report says the approach reverses the traditional sequence used in many fusion concepts.
topics.detail: The article says the work suggests a dramatically more efficient path to fusion energy. It identifies Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory as the source of the finding and describes the method as reversing the usual order of operations.

sources.title: Scientists may have found a shortcut to fusion energy

topics.title: Study warns deep-sea mining can disrupt seafloor microbes
topics.summary: A report covered by Yahoo News said scientists from the Chinese Academy of Sciences found that deep-sea mining can rapidly disrupt microbes tied to nutrient cycling on the South China Sea floor. The article said the findings show the impact of disturbance on deep-sea ecosystems can appear quickly.
topics.detail: The story said the paper offers a preview of how mining can affect seafloor ecosystems. It also noted that commercial deep-sea mining has not started yet, while the International Seabed Authority has issued exploration contracts.

sources.title: A Deep-Sea Mining Trial Rapidly Threw The Seafloor Ecosystem Off ...

topics.title: American Metal advances US seabed mining licence bid
topics.summary: Mining.com.au reported that NOAA certified two exploration licence applications from American Metal subsidiaries for Pacific seabed minerals. The company said the applications cover part of the Clarion-Clipperton Zone in international waters.
topics.detail: The article said NOAA will now complete an environmental study as the next step in the process. It also quoted American Metal CEO David Ruddell as saying he wants a commercial mining permit within three years.

sources.title: American Metal says US seabed mining exploration licence application advances

topics.title: Fusion leaders to discuss the field at Fermilab
topics.summary: Fermilab said laboratory and industry leaders will gather on Oct. 13 for a public discussion on the future of fusion energy. The event included speakers from Lawrence Livermore, Fermilab, Argonne and Oak Ridge national laboratories.
topics.detail: The notice said Kim Budil of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory would present on the promise, progress and path ahead for fusion. It said the session would be held at Fermilab in Batavia, Illinois.

sources.title: National laboratory and industry leaders to discuss the future of fusion at Fermilab

topics.title: ESA says Japan’s MMX mission is set for launch
topics.summary: ESA said the Martian Moons eXploration mission is set to launch on Oct. 19 or 20 from the Tanegashima Space Center. The mission aims to collect a sample from Phobos and return it to Earth.
topics.detail: ESA said MMX is expected to enter orbit around Mars in August 2027 and orbit Phobos from September 2027. The launch timing was given in local and European time zones.

sources.title: Mars moon lander set to launch on 19 October
